content: AI pixel art: PixelLab (sub $12-50/mo, skeleton animation, tilesets, Aseprite ext, API/MCP), Retro Diffusion (one-time $20/$65 Aseprite ext, local GPU, outputs owned by user), Scenario/Layer custom-trained styles. Cleanup tools: proper-pixel-art (MIT, pip), unfake 1.0.7 (MIT, pip, Oct 2025). Aseprite ~$19.99 CLI batch export. Steam requires AI pre-generated content disclosure on store page (Jan 2024 policy). Sources: cinevva Sept 2026 comparison, pypi, github, search.
